text:
Alex (Finance Lead): Quick Q3 spend guardrails — please read. Effective immediately: all new vendor commitments >= $8,000 need a PO and Procurement sign-off. Recurring services >= $2,500/mo also require a PO. One-off ad-hoc buys under $1,000 can use corporate card if tagged. Link: https://intra.redwood.com/finance/q3-guardrails :bookmark_tabs:

Nina (Procurement): Add practical notes: vendor-onboard required for any new vendor. Short POCs (<=60 days) can request a "PO: POC" with capped spend. Retro-POs allowed only with Procurement justification and manager approval. Email procure@redwood.com to start.

Jon (Eng): For bench GPU credits billed monthly ~ $2,700 — that's over the recurring threshold. Do we submit a PO or can Eng get a temporary card exception?

Nina (Procurement): PO required. For short trials we can fast-track a 60-day PO if you include scope and cost cap in the request. Use the POC fast-track checkbox on the onboard form.

Cara (Sales Ops): Sales uses promo bundles that hit $9k occasionally. Can we request a single PO for campaign credits?

Alex (Finance Lead): Yes, Sales Ops may request a campaign PO. Include timebox and expected spend. We'll prioritize customer-facing revenue-generating activities.

Rae (Legal): Reminder: any vendor touching customer data or production infra needs Contract Intake before signature. No PO without Legal clearance for data/infra access. Use: https://intra.redwood.com/contract-intake :scroll:

SpendBot: SYSTEM: Auto-check enabled. Invoices >= $8,000 without PO will be flagged and put on hold. Missing project_tag or cost_center will trigger a Slack DM to requester.

Jon (Eng): What about purchases via marketplace resale partners that bill in bulk quarterly? They're non-US vendors.

Nina (Procurement): For non-US vendors, include tax/withholding docs if required. If you expect cross-border billing > $10k annually, mark as "reseller" so AP can collect docs.

Alex (Finance Lead): TL;DR: >= $8k single invoice or >= $2.5k/month recurring = PO + procurement. Card OK < $1k with tags. Use vendor-onboard + contract intake for data/infra. Retro-POs limited. Drop-in Q&A Friday 3pm PT. Thanks! :wave:
